name: R.S Furniture (Factory Outlet)
tagline: Pooja units, wardrobes, beds and TV units in Koramangala
address: Kotak Mahindra Bank, Jakkasandra, 1st Block Koramangala, HSR Layout 5th Sector
about:
R.S Furniture (Factory Outlet) is a furniture store in Jakkasandra, 1st Block Koramangala, Bengaluru.
We sell pooja units, beds and diwans, wardrobes, TV units, crockery units, storage cabinets, study tables and reception counters. Come and see the pieces, check the finish and pick what fits your home or office.
Send us a WhatsApp message with the product you like and we will share the price.
metaDescription: R.S Furniture (Factory Outlet), Jakkasandra, Koramangala 1st Block, Bengaluru. Pooja units, wardrobes, beds, TV units, storage and study tables.

categoryIntros.Pooja Units: Pooja mandirs and pooja cabinets with jaali doors, temple tops and drawers for pooja items. White, light wood and walnut finishes for every home.
categoryIntros.Beds and Diwans: Double beds with cane and glass panel headboards, plus a diwan with a tufted back that works as a sofa by day and a guest bed by night.
categoryIntros.Wardrobes: Two-door and sliding door wardrobes with hanging space, shelves and inner drawers. Sliding doors are a good choice for small bedrooms.
categoryIntros.TV Units: Low TV units with cabinets, open shelves and a cane drawer. Space for the set-top box, speakers, remotes and decor.
categoryIntros.Crockery and Display Units: Crockery and display units with glass doors and shelves to show off glasses, dinner sets and showpieces. One has built-in lights.
categoryIntros.Storage Cabinets: Storage cabinets, a cane sideboard and a low unit with drawers. Use them for shoes, toys, books and everyday items.
categoryIntros.Tables and Desks: Computer tables, study tables, a coffee table and an L-shape reception counter for homes, shops, clinics and offices.
